name: Zalazane's Fall (subzone)
summary: Zalazane's Fall is a corrupted islet situated among the Echo Isles off the southeastern coast of Durotar. It marks the desolate ground closely tied to the treacherous witch doctor Zalazane and the dark voodoo plaguing the Darkspear tribe.

sections.title: A Blighted Isle
sections.body: Lying just off the shores of the main Echo Isles, this corrupted patch of land bears the dark imprint of Zalazane's treachery. Driven mad by lust for power, the witch doctor enslaved many of his Darkspear kin with vile hexes and dark voodoo, forcing Vol'jin and the remaining tribe to evacuate to the mainland village of Sen'jin. Even amid the waters of the Southfury river mouth, the dark energies emanating from Zalazane's hold continue to blight the local wildlife and surrounding islets.

sections.title: The Shadow of the Witch Doctor
sections.body: For the Darkspear trolls, this part of the archipelago serves as a grim testament to betrayal from within their own ranks. Zalazane's dark sorcery lingers heavily over the rocks and sand, ensnaring minds and corrupting creatures that stray too near. Young Horde warriors and scouts sent into the Echo Isles must tread carefully, as the taint of his hexes makes the surrounding waters as perilous as the maddened thralls who guard them.

faq.answer: It is located within the Echo Isles, a cluster of islands situated off the southeastern coast of Durotar, south of Darkspear Strand.

Zalazane was once a respected witch doctor of the Darkspear tribe who succumbed to dark ambitions and madness. He turned his dark voodoo on his own people, enslaving their minds and driving the surviving trolls out of their island settlement.

faq.q: Why are the Echo Isles in turmoil?
faq.answer: The Darkspears settled the Echo Isles after fleeing the Great Sea, but Zalazane's betrayal stripped them of their home. Vol'jin led the survivors to Sen'jin Village on the Durotar mainland, where they now fight to reclaim their lands.

faq.q: Why is the ground here corrupted?
faq.answer: Zalazane's practitioners and their foul hexes seep deeply into the land and local fauna, creating pockets of tainted ground and twisted wildlife across the archipelago.

angles.text: The blighted islands of the Echo Isles represent the ultimate betrayal of the Darkspear tribe by one of their own, making every venture into Zalazane's domain a matter of personal honor and survival.
Securing the Echo Isles and eliminating the threat of Zalazane's dark voodoo is essential to maintaining the security of Durotar's southern coastline.
